provider_rules: Character visual design must happen before model prompt compilation.
Model-specific Prompt Skills cannot invent identity facts.
Character generation keeps front master identity strategy and reference editing constraints.
Runtime cannot bypass Skill-authored prompts with raw entity text concatenation.
completion_criteria: Reference media is persisted and bound
failure_policy: Missing character visual design packet blocks character generation
